card.name: Exception and linking words in instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'except' and 'and' that come right after a drug-use clause and introduce a qualification or a second time point, as in 'initiating and titrating X and when...' or 'treatment initiation and dose increases'.

modes.label: Except clauses
modes.description: The word 'except' starts an exception to a dosing or administration instruction.
modes.example: The recommended injection site is the abdomen,<< except>> for 2 inches (5 cm)

modes.label: And joining time points
modes.description: 'and' links a second situation after 'initiating' or 'initiation', such as titration or dose increases.
modes.example: particularly when initiating and titrating OLINVYK<< and>> when OLINVYK is given con

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like 'except' and 'and' that add an exception or a second situation to an instruction.
